Sandbox resources and pricing

This page covers resource configuration and pricing for Modal Sandboxes. Modal Sandboxes have elastic resourcing. They automatically “burst” beyond their CPU and memory requests. You’re charged max(request, actual) for both CPU and memory. When bursting, charging max(request, actual) means you only pay for active-resources. Pay for what you use. By default, each Sandbox requests 0.125 CPU cores and 128 MiB of memory. Not setting a resource request means you only pay for the resources your Sandbox is actively using each second, with the small default request as the minimum.
